description: For too long, our voice has been lost in the shuffle of the elites and special interests. The status quo is working for the insiders, but it’s failing our community. I'm running for State Senate to be the independent voice we’ve been missing, a fighter who answers to his neighbors, not the well-connected. Let’s send a message to Hartford: We’re taking our seat back.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Perry 2026, Stacey Dolan Treasurer
title: Jack Perry for State Senate
